Impact at an Individual level

You begin at a 700 / 1000 wellbeing baseline. The movie then moves your 6 wellbeing nodes, one scene at a time.

Physiology

Body state, movement, rest, breath, tension.

Emotion

Biochemical charge and emotional temperature.

Feeling

The felt experience of the film in the moment.

Thought

Mental model, perspective, and cognitive shift.

Habit

Cue, routine, choice, and streak pressure.

Performance

Learning, earning, skill, and community value.
